Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1169600. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
